hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && node_modules/.bin/prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; case "$f" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx) node_modules/.bin/oxlint "$f" >&2 || exit 2;; esac
